scope.not_a_new_full_source_review: Read prior independent candidate source review and impacted complete delta. This native/cost review does not replace its deeper source verdict or approve another stack head.
scope.reviewer_actions: Read-only source, receipts and installed API; independent arithmetic and hashing. No source/index/ref/GitHub/runtime change, build, execution of scripts/probes/tests/GC, or new measurement.

r2_benchmark.r1_handling: R1 source used lagged Gc.quick_stat allocation counters and is retained historical evidence only. R2 replaces precisely that allocated helper with current-domain Gc.counters; R1 allocation figures are superseded, not combined with R2.
r2_benchmark.api: Installed OCaml5.5.2 gc.mli257-268 distinguishes lagging quick_stat snapshots from current-domain/potential previous-domain counters. Formula minor+major-promoted, multiplied by8 assumes the64-bit local host. Scope is the direct owned fixture domain, not all-domain runtime allocation.
r2_benchmark.design: Eight fresh owned-process runs form four AB/BA pairs: AB,BA,AB,BA. Each process always runs the same four fixture rows:2000 messages with128-byte body;512 with4096-byte body; original and decoded identity modes. Each row has one timed cold plan, an untimed full-major collection, then100 timed warm calls. Benchmark code itself spawns no domain.
r2_benchmark.raw_integrity: All eight aggregate rows match their per-side raw stdout; exit0 and all retained R2 stderr empty. Both copied bench.ml files equal bench-r2.ml. All96 candidate/baseline pair ratios and24 median fields recomputed exactly with no mismatch; encoded_memo_bytes equals across sides within each paired row.
r2_benchmark.compile_binding: Both R2 benchmark compilations/link commands exit0. Compilers retain fatal4/8/32/69. Each link explicitly names its baseline-r1 or candidate-r1 Objects_under_test CMX and its own freshly compiled benchmark CMX; suites do likewise. Complete actual isolated ML/MLI and existing actual dependency archives were used, with the appropriate own leaf first for typing.
r2_benchmark.semantic_oracle: Within each side, the final warm plan head_bytes and content digest equal its cold first plan after100 calls. Runner also checks equal encoded memo byte counts across sides. This is not direct cross-side equality of every object/wire byte or each iteration, nor a substitute for maintained tests.
r2_benchmark.estimator_precision: Reported CPU ratios are medians of four paired ratios. The approximately+54us/+8us statements use differences of the side medians (53.825us/8.135us), not median paired differences (53.055us/9.440us); both are included explicitly.
r2_benchmark.cost_assessment: Small original-row CPU is slower in all4 pairs: median paired ratio1.20817 (+20.817%), with allocation+17.1978% /31984B per call. Large original allocation also rises9.00987% /8176B per call. Small decoded allocation is essentially unchanged (-16B/call) but CPU ratio1.03940; large decoded CPU ratio0.94877 is a scoped fixture result, not an overall speedup. This is a memory-retention repair with a measured original-prefix CPU/allocation cost.
r2_benchmark.limits: Only four pairs and fixed within-process fixture order; CPU is Sys.time process CPU, wall time is noisy. Synthetic user-text fixtures are distinct from the16MiB omitted ToolResult.json probe. No workload mix/frequency, confidence interval, aggregate CPU benefit, server throughput, end-to-end latency, current RSS or runtime recovery follows. Full-major preparation is outside the warm timed region; natural workload GC schedules can differ.

remaining_boundaries: Native receipts use prebuilt actual dependencies; broad includes/link success do not attest a fresh whole source dependency graph, Dune manifests, full product build, CI, release, installed binary or current server.
Public/private source authority, validation/error paths and one-memo-per-sequence semantics remain subject to the exact source review; these native receipts do not certify cross-domain memo sharing.
Weak.get can affect liveness during incremental collection. The active decoded-lineage control is bounded; arbitrary ongoing weak-access schedules and time-to-release are unmeasured.
No new P0/P1/P2 defect is established within the reviewed native/cost scope. The measured cost must remain visible in any memory-repair proposal; no CPU-speedup claim is supported.
